# Aqua Ventures Coorg

> Parent holding company for four specialized sustainable D2C food and agri brands: Just Meen, Just Homemade, Just Fresh, and Just Grow. Based in Guyya Village, Siddapur, Kodagu (Coorg), Karnataka. Operating under FSSAI State License No: 11223319000027.

## Core D2C Brands & Offerings
- [Just Meen Seafood](https://aquaventurescoorg.com/#catalog): Pure spring-water Tilapia boneless fillets (₹600/kg), Jumbo Prawns 16/20 (₹650/500g), Medium IQF Prawns (₹600/500g), Handcrafted Fish Momos (₹300/10pcs), Marinated Fish Tikka (₹300/350g), Crispy Fish Croquettes (₹300/10pcs), Fish Fingers (₹300/10pcs), Kaimeen Fish Pickle (₹250/200g).
- [Just Homemade Preserves & Pantry](https://aquaventurescoorg.com/#catalog): Kaipuli (Wild Seville Orange) Marmalade (₹250/350g), Authentic Wood-Fired Coorg Kachampuli Vinegar (₹250/150ml), Kaipuli Bitter Lime Pickle (₹190/250g), Traditional Cut Mango Pickle (₹180/250g), Coorg Black Pepper & Lime Pickle (₹250/250g), Estate Passion Fruit Squash (₹350/750ml), Raw Unpasteurized Forest & Apiary Honey (₹1,250/kg), Artisan Farm Malai Paneer (₹180/200g).
- [Just Fresh Hydroponics & Specialties](https://aquaventurescoorg.com/#catalog): Soilless Butterhead & Romaine Lettuce (₹80/pack), Tender Spinach / Palak (₹50/250g), Fresh Genovese Basil Pesto.
- [Just Grow Bio-Nutrition](https://aquaventurescoorg.com/#catalog): Organic Cold-Hydrolyzed Liquid Fish Fertilizer 1L (₹400), 5L Estate Can (₹1,500). All-purpose liquid plant food and soil bio-stimulant.
- [Commercial B2B Aquaculture](https://aquaventurescoorg.com/#b2b): High-vigor fingerlings (Catla, Rohu, Grass Carp, Murrel) for commercial aquaculture operators.

## Delivery Logistics
- Local Coorg / Kodagu Doorstep: Same-day / next-day estate dispatch. Free above ₹800.
- Regional Next-Day Express: Temperature-controlled insulated sub-zero cold-chain (-18°C) with food-grade dry ice. Free above ₹1,500.
- Farm-to-Kitchen Wholesale: Dedicated refrigerated transport for resort and restaurant partners. Free above ₹3,000.
- Pan-India Ambient Shipping: Express dispatch for shelf-stable preserves, honey, and Just Grow liquid fertilizer. Free above ₹1,200.

## Farm Tour & Riverbank Tasting Experience
- Rate: ₹1,500 per Adult | ₹800 per Child (5-12 years).
- Schedule: Daily morning slot (10:00 AM - 1:30 PM with farm lunch) and evening slot (3:00 PM - 6:30 PM with riverside high tea).
- Highlights: Bio-secure concrete raceways, live fish feeding, automated hydroponic nutrient-film greenhouses, honeybee apiaries, and a farm-to-table lunch served on a secluded deck overlooking the Cauvery tributary.
